familyContent.summary: Topaz Bloom is creative enlargement for AI images, illustrations and digital artwork. Three presets add detail as the picture grows to a 2K, 4K or 8K tier. Describe the look with an optional prompt, and set how freely the model can reinterpret the source with `creativity`.
familyContent.seoTitle: Topaz Bloom API — Creative Upscaling with Bloom 2
familyContent.seoDescription: Grow AI images and illustrations with Bloom 2, Bloom or Bloom Realism. Guide added detail with a prompt and creativity control at 2K, 4K or 8K.

faq.question: What does creativity 9 mean?
faq.answer: It allows the most new detail within Bloom’s creativity range. At 1 the interpretation stays closest to the input; the default is 3.

faq.question: Can I leave the prompt empty?
faq.answer: Yes. Our portrait tests used no prompt at all. A description is optional guidance for the additional detail.

faq.question: Does Bloom Realism cost more than Bloom 2?
faq.answer: At the same resolution tier, the presets have the same per-image price. Neither creativity nor output format changes the charge.

data.description:
## Creative enlargement

Bloom adds a creative reconstruction pass while increasing image size. `bloom_2` is selected when you omit `preset`.

## Bloom request

Set `resolution` to `2k`, `4k` or `8k`; the default is `4k`. `creativity` defaults to 3 and `prompt` is optional.

## Creative boundaries

Check new faces and textures in the downloaded JPEG or PNG. `bloom_realism` rejects creativity above 4 even though the other two models accept up to 9.

paramNotes.creativity: Integer 1–9, default 3: 1 stays closest to the source and 9 adds the most detail. With `bloom_realism`, only 1–4 is valid.
paramNotes.image_url: The existing picture whose composition Bloom will expand and reinterpret.
paramNotes.output_format: Choose `jpeg` or `png` for the Bloom download; selecting the format has no effect on price.
paramNotes.preset: `bloom_2` is the latest default; `bloom` suits illustration and CG, while `bloom_realism` aims for a natural photographic finish.
paramNotes.prompt: Optional description of the scene or desired finish to guide Bloom’s new details.
paramNotes.resolution: Bloom’s output tier: `2k`, `4k` by default, or `8k`. This selection alone determines the billing tier.

creativity.description: How freely the image is reinterpreted: 1 stays closest to the source, 9 adds the most new detail. bloom_realism accepts 1 to 4; higher values are refused for that preset. Does not change the price.

image_url.description: The image to upscale creatively, usually an AI render or artwork: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Composition and aspect ratio are kept.

output_format.description: File type of the returned image. png avoids another round of lossy compression but is several times larger. The format does not change the price.

preset.description: Which Topaz Bloom model to run. bloom_2 is the newest and invents the most convincing new detail; bloom suits illustrations, artwork and CG; bloom_realism keeps a natural, photographic look and only accepts creativity 1 to 4.

prompt.description: Optional description of the image or of the result you want; it steers what the new detail looks like. Leave it empty to let the model describe the image itself.

resolution.description: Output size: a pixel budget of about 4 MP (2k), 16.8 MP (4k) or 67 MP (8k) with the source aspect ratio kept. The price depends on this tier only.

data.pricingNote: For Bloom, only the selected `resolution` tier changes the per-image charge. Preset, prompt, creativity and JPEG/PNG selection do not alter that price.
data.readme:
## Creative enlargement

Expand one existing image with Bloom 2, Bloom or Bloom Realism, using an optional prompt and a creativity setting to guide newly invented detail.

## Bloom request

```json
{
  "image_url": "https://example.com/blurred-portrait.jpg",
  "preset": "bloom_2",
  "resolution": "2k",
  "creativity": 3,
  "output_format": "jpeg"
}
```

## Choose an interpretation

| `preset` | Creative direction |
|---|---|
| `bloom_2` | Latest default creative enlargement model |
| `bloom` | Illustration, art and CG enlargement |
| `bloom_realism` | Natural photographic appearance; creativity limited to 1–4 |

## Portrait trial

At 2K and creativity 3 without a prompt, Bloom 2 reconstructed eyes, stubble and visible skin texture from our blurred portrait. Added detail is an interpretation of the face, not proof of what the camera captured.

Left to right: Bloom 2, Bloom Realism, Bloom. Bloom 2 looks more textured; Realism gives a clearer face with slight changes in likeness; original Bloom stays softer in this trial. The three runs took about 86, 134 and 273 seconds respectively.

## Creative boundaries

Bloom deliberately invents detail and can change faces, textures or small objects. Use it when that creative change is welcome. `creativity` must be an integer from 1–9, and only 1–4 with `bloom_realism`; larger Realism values are rejected. Timing varies by image and preset.

examples.note: Bloom 2 used creativity 3 without a prompt: the 1100×900 soft portrait became a textured 2264×1852 image in about 86 seconds.
Bloom Realism at creativity 3 returned a 2264×1852 portrait in about 134 seconds, with clearer facial detail and small changes in appearance.
